title: Quiver Bases of Cartan Squares of Minuscule Representations
summary: We consider the Cartan square $V^{2λ}$ of a minuscule representation $V^λ$ of a simply laced complex simple Lie algebra $\mathfrak g$. We construct for $V^{2λ}$ a family of bases, which we call quiver bases, each indexed by the set $\operatorname{RPP}_2(P_λ)$ of reverse plane partitions of height two on the minuscule poset $P_λ$ of $V^λ$. Let $Q$ be a quiver on the Dynkin diagram of $\mathfrak g$, and let $c_Q$ be the corresponding Coxeter element.
